description: Generator-based pair-mode evaluation history for Checks 7 and 8. Each entry records a generation run, its purpose, and the metric outcomes. Entries are cumulative: each builds on the state of the codebase at the time it was run.

seed_range_map.note: MBPP seeds start at ID 601 in the project's loader (skip first 600 in the HuggingFace dataset). skip-seeds N advances N rows in the loader.
seed_range_map.mbpp-601..660: eval_mbpp601-660.jsonl — open-mode TP pool used during Check 7+8 development (calibration phase)
seed_range_map.mbpp-661..700: eval_mbpp661-700.jsonl + calibration_mbpp661-700.jsonl — independent validation split (never seen during development)
seed_range_map.mbpp-701..740: eval_mbpp701-740.jsonl — secondary comparison split (Check 7 compare-return extension)
seed_range_map.mbpp-741..780: eval_mbpp741-780.jsonl + calibration_mbpp741-780.jsonl — floor-lowering experiment split (floor=2 vs floor=1)

runs.purpose: Initial calibration — develop and threshold Checks 7 and 8

results.note: Development split — not used for final metric reporting. Used to set _ORIG_COMPLEXITY_FLOOR, literal specificity filters, and taint analysis parameters.

runs.purpose: Independent validation — first unseen-seed evaluation of Checks 7+8 (floor=2)

results.fp_root_cause: 4 hard TN FPs from Check 1 (3x) and Check 2 (1x); 0 from Checks 7 or 8

results.decision: Both floors lowered to 1. Zero precision cost on 75 clean pairs.
results.fp_checks_breakdown: All 5 hard TN FPs across all configs: Check 1 (4x) and Check 2 (1x). Zero from Check 7 or 8 at any floor setting.

results.conclusion: Consistent with floor experiment. Same direction (+recall), zero precision cost. Floor decision confirmed on two independent splits.
